The interactive analyses have moved to dedicated pages:

- [Vocabulary Norms](norms.qmd) — vocabulary size growth curves
- [Item Trajectories](trajectories.qmd) — developmental trajectories of individual words
- [Cross-Linguistic Trajectories](crossling.qmd) — words compared across languages via uni-lemmas
- [Semantic Networks](networks.qmd) — embedding-based word networks
- [CDI Scoring](scoring.qmd) — percentile scoring for your own administrations
- [Data downloads](data.qmd) — by-child, by-word, and child-by-word exports

Analysis reports from the Wordbank team:

- [Predicting Words' Age of Acquisition](https://mikabr.github.io/aoa-prediction/aoa_prediction.html)
- [Estimating Words' Age of Acquisition](https://mikabr.github.io/aoa-prediction/aoa_estimation.html)
- [Vocabulary Composition Trajectories](https://mikabr.github.io/vocab-comp/)
- [Relationship between Lexicon and Grammar](https://dyurovsky.github.io/cdi-grammar/)
- [Maternal Education Differences in Vocabulary](https://mikabr.github.io/demo-vocab/momed.html)
- [Gender Differences in Vocabulary](https://mikabr.github.io/demo-vocab/gender.html)

For the full picture, see the [Wordbank book](https://wordbank-book.stanford.edu).
